svg.title: One extension run
svg.desc: relate opens the store, starts the extension, and writes its flag values to its stdin as one JSON line. The extension sends initialize and notifications/initialized, then tool calls such as write_cypher, which relate runs against the store and answers. The extension's last call is report_output, which relate prints as the run's summary before it exits.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center; width: 280px;

span.p: relate run opens the store and starts the extension

span.p: The extension sends initialize, then notifications/initialized

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 280px; text-align: center; width: 280px;

span.p: The extension sends tools/call requests; relate runs each one against the store and answers
